description: A small white glasses case sits on the bed in front of you, with a dark pillow propped up behind it. The left hand reaches forward to the case and lifts it while the right hand comes in to help open it, making the case a two-hand object; then the right hand pinches and pulls a pair of glasses out so the glasses become a right-hand object as the left hand lets the case fall back onto the bed. The glasses are then rotated and unfolded between the hands, and the right hand lowers them toward the bed to set them down.
